from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException, status
import polars as pl
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/crm")

@router.post("/enrich-leads-csv")
async def enrich_uploaded_leads(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    content = await file.read()
    uploaded_df = pl.read_csv(io.BytesIO(content))

    if "customer_id" not in uploaded_df.columns:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, detail="Missing customer_id column")

    # Vulnerable: Joins user CSV against global master customers parquet without filtering by current tenant
    master_customers = pl.read_parquet("/storage/crm/customers_master.parquet")
    enriched_df = uploaded_df.join(master_customers, on="customer_id", how="inner")

    return {
        "matched_records": len(enriched_df),
        "results": enriched_df.select(["customer_id", "email", "full_name", "annual_revenue", "credit_score"]).to_dicts()
    }
diagnosis: The CRM lead enrichment route reads user-uploaded customer IDs and joins them against the global customers_master.parquet table using Polars. It never scopes the master DataFrame by current_user.tenant_id. An attacker from Tenant A can upload known or guessed customer IDs to retrieve the full names, emails, revenues, and credit scores of customers belonging to Tenant B.

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException, status
import polars as pl
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/crm")

@router.post("/enrich-leads-csv")
async def enrich_uploaded_leads(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    content = await file.read()
    uploaded_df = pl.read_csv(io.BytesIO(content))

    if "customer_id" not in uploaded_df.columns:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, detail="Missing customer_id column")

    # Filter master table to only include records belonging to current_user.tenant_id
    master_customers = pl.read_parquet("/storage/crm/customers_master.parquet").filter(
        pl.col("tenant_id") == current_user.tenant_id
    )
    enriched_df = uploaded_df.join(master_customers, on="customer_id", how="inner")

    return {
        "matched_records": len(enriched_df),
        "results": enriched_df.select(["customer_id", "email", "full_name", "annual_revenue", "credit_score"]).to_dicts()
    }
